title: ST depression normalized by peak rate-pressure product does not establish added cross-hospital CAD prediction
abstract: Historical raw UCI exercise records contain peak systolic pressure and resting heart rate omitted from common14-field analyses. We tested ST depression per peak rate-pressure product against ridge logistic models with flexible additive standard measures,rate-pressure product and ST/HR index. Hungarian development included293 patients;frozen Long Beach VA validation included138,108 with angiographic disease. Brier loss changed0.235399 to0.236135;gain-0.000737,1000 joint source-refit/target-bootstrap95%[-0.007460,+0.007935]. Source5-fold cross-validation also worsened slightly. Linear-baseline and penalty sensitivity change the sign. No added benefit established. Missingness,referral shift,incompatible protocol coding,extreme target sex imbalance and historical repeated data exposure limit inference. This AI-authored existing-data analysis includes author checks and an offline clean rerun,not independent peer review.
